uk.s: Brazil New User Exclusive: Subscribe to USDT Simple Earn to Enjoy 15% APR!
You can continue earning a est. 4% KCUSD APR rewards every day!

Binance is excited to announce this week’s Binance Starter Carnival promotion on Simple Earn Flexible Products for all eligible new users*! Eligible new users who complete any amount of deposit can get an exclusive 15% Bonus Tiered APR rewards for 7 days on USDT Flexible Products on top of Real-Time APR rewards.

Note: This offer is only available to users in Brazil. Only users who have completed identity verification (KYC) with Brazil as their KYC country/region are eligible. Users may check USDT Flexible Products to see offer details.
The promotion is available for all newly registered users in Brazil, who registered on the Binance platform after 2026-11-23 13:00:00 (UTC) and whose identity verification country is Brazil.
Plus, complete the required trading tasks to earn a share of the 500,000 USDT prize pool! The higher your cumulative trading volume, the bigger your rewards, with up to 100 USDT per user!
100% of eligible TradFi trading fees incurred during the campaign will be rebated as Futures Trial Funds, after deducting agent commissions.
All rewards will be distributed as Futures Trial Funds within 7 business days after the campaign ends and data verification is completed.

During the campaign, all users, both new and existing, can enjoy zero trading fees across all TradFi products. Trade gold, forex, U.S. stocks, major global indices, and more while exploring opportunities across global markets!
Users must log in to Hotcoin and click "Join Now" on the campaign page to register. Trading activity from unregistered users will not count toward Event 2 rewards.

All rewards will be distributed as Futures Trial Funds within 7 business days after the campaign ends and data verification is completed. The types, denominations, validity periods, and usage rules are subject to the details displayed on the relevant Hotcoin product pages.

Dear Hotcoiners,
Exciting TradFi trading benefits are here! The Hotcoin TradFi 0 Fee Carnival kicks off soon!
Sign-up Now
Event 1: Zero Trading Fees Across All TradFi Products
During the campaign, all Hotcoin users can enjoy zero trading fees across all available TradFi products on the platform, helping reduce trading costs.
Event 2: Trade More & Share a 500,000 USDT Prize Pool!
During the campaign, users can unlock tiered rewards by reaching cumulative eligible trading volume milestones in TradFi Spot and Futures trading, with up to 100 USDT per user!
Eligible TradFi Trading Volume · Reward
≥ 1,000 USDT · 5 USDT
≥ 5,000 USDT · 10 USDT
≥ 20,000 USDT · 20 USDT
≥ 50,000 USDT · 50 USDT
≥ 100,000 USDT · 100 USDT
Event 1 is open to all Hotcoin users. 100% of eligible TradFi trading fees incurred during the campaign will be rebated as Futures Trial Funds, after deducting agent commissions.
Event 1 rebates exclude agent commissions, spreads, overnight interest, funding fees, and other trading costs. Final rebate amounts are subject to Hotcoin's calculations and verification.
Event 2 is based on cumulative eligible TradFi Spot and Futures trading volume during the campaign. Only the highest tier achieved applies; rewards from different tiers cannot be combined.
The campaign covers all TradFi products available on Hotcoin, including gold, forex, U.S. stocks, and major global indices, subject to actual availability.
Only genuine, eligible trades executed during the campaign will count toward trading volume. Abnormal trading, wash trading, self-trading, and other prohibited activities will be excluded.

The campaign features two separate prize pools: 100,000 USDT for Event 1 fee rebates (up to 300 USDT per user) and 500,000 USDT for Event 2 trading rewards. Each event follows its own rules, with rewards available until the respective prize pool is exhausted.
Users who engage in bulk account registrations, malicious arbitrage, fraudulent trading, or other prohibited activities may be disqualified and have their rewards revoked.
Hotcoin reserves the right to modify, interpret, or terminate this campaign to the extent permitted by applicable law.
Thank you for your continued support and trust in Hotcoin.
Teams that successfully enter the top 50 will share the prize pool
Team Profit Leaderboard
Best Team Captain
The top 30 captains with the highest number of eligible team members will share rewards
The below table shows progressive tiers. The bonus APR is calculated cumulatively, rather than applying a single rate to eligible users’ entire subscription amount.
Minimum Subscription Limit per Eligible User
Maximum Subscription Limit per Eligible User
Real-Time APR + 15% Bonus Tiered APR (0 - 200 USDT)
Bonus Tiered APR rewards are calculated based on the subscribed amounts and are subject to the respective tier limit for each token. Please refer to this FAQ for more details.

Eligible users who subscribe to USDT Simple Earn Flexible Products promotion will receive both Real-Time APR and Bonus Tiered APR rewards for up to 7 days for USDT during the Promotion Period. Before the Promotion Period ends, users can enjoy the bonus apr rate within the 7-day period after the first subscription. Redemption within the 7-day period will terminate the reward accrual of the Bonus Tiered APR rewards from the redemption day. After the Promotion Period ends, users will only be entitled to Real-Time APR rewards.

Example: New User A subscribes to USDT Flexible Products on 2026-11-26, redeems on 2026-11-29, and resubscribes on 2026-11-30. Bonus Tiered APR rewards will accrue on 2026-11-27, 2026-11-28, and 2026-10-01, and be distributed to User A on 2026-11-28, 2026-11-29, and 2026-12-02. Bonus Tiered APR rewards are calculated based on the subscribed amounts and are subject to the respective tier limit for each token. Please refer to this FAQ for more details.
The Promotion’s subscription amount of each user has an upper limit. When the upper limit is reached, users will no longer be able to subscribe.
